_comment: Synthetic contract fixture for Anthropic GET /v1/organizations/spend_limits/effective (2026 Enterprise Spend Limits API; Admin key via the x-api-key header, scope read:spend_limits). data[] items carry scope={type:user,user_id}; amount / period_to_date_spend are nullable decimal strings in minor USD cents (fractional cents allowed, up to 4 decimals; 1 cent = 10000 micros); only an explicit null means no hard limit / unknown spend — a missing (non-null) field is a parse error; every user-scoped entry must carry currency=USD and period=monthly; window is monthly and resets at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of each month.
_auth: Admin API key (x-api-key + anthropic-version) with scope read:spend_limits
_pagination: follow next_page; pass the URL-encoded cursor as page=<next_page> until next_page is absent; exceeding the page cap with a live cursor must error
_unit: amount / period_to_date_spend are nullable decimal strings in minor USD cents (fractional cents allowed, up to 4 decimals)
